scope: Exercise-focused synthesis. Record routing and report catalogue evidence use separate counting units.

template.citation: Page MJ et al. BMJ 2021;372:n71. doi:10.1136/bmj.n71.
template.type: New systematic reviews with databases, registers and other sources

sequential_records_excluded_before_retri.reason: 13,050 record carrier exclusion routes are documented. Ordering relative to retrieval is incomplete, and some archived requests concern initial screening or another carrier.

reports_sought.reason: 263 is the identified archived request union. Request purposes differ, and the record frame lacks an exhaustive chronology and selected report-target map.

reports_not_retrieved.reason: 61 was a historical count within 173 requests. Later evidence and different purposes prevent conversion to a final all-review count. Lack of a verified complete body is not proof of nonretrieval.

reports_assessed.reason: Historical archive tracks 109 human and 3 later AI reviews; 182 is positive complete-body evidence in the broader request union. Acquisition and eligibility assessment are distinct events.

reports_excluded_by_reason.reason: The catalogue contains 84 outside the focused scope and 36 without a randomized effect. These categories lack an exhaustive formal eligibility sequence. 114 remain awaiting classification.

reports_included.reason: 85 principal report carriers support the approved bounded synthesis. The 392 catalogue rows lack all-review eligibility dispositions.

independent_trial_K.reason: 84 source-supported families are in the bounded synthesis. Unmapped/unresolved reports and final selection prevent a review-wide count.

independent_unique_participant_N.reason: Final independently eligible trials and reconciled participant denominators are unavailable. Use comparison-specific observed denominators only.

additional_provenance.source_count_split: Embase Registry, ClinicalTrials.gov, and WHO ICTRP are registers. Other focused export members are database records.
additional_provenance.documented_exclusion_route: Chronology relative to report retrieval could not be recovered. The sequential record-exclusion field is unknown.
